integrity: The claim is a conditional exact geometric theorem with analytic proof. The computations test formulas only; they are not exhaustive proofs. No independent external review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Positive width at most half a great circle, regular spherical Reuleaux odd-gons with odd n at least three.
Spherical endpoint width pi/2 and general spherical Barbier identity have prior sources.
No claim about irregular constant-width bodies, larger widths, or quantitative shape convergence.
Leichtweiss (2005) was bibliographically identified but complete article was not available.
title: Sharp area convergence of regular spherical Reuleaux odd-gons
